description:
Implement the new bridge runtime, API, and CLI as a greenfield scenario reusing the vrooli-bridge slot after retirement of the legacy implementation.

The job of this runtime is trusted-node connectivity and task/session transport between Vrooli machines. It is not a continuation of the legacy external-project documentation-injection mission.
name: greenfield-vrooli-bridge-core-runtime
title: Implement The Greenfield Bridge Core Runtime
